# CV Workbench

> CV Workbench is an ATS-friendly web CV builder that turns structured career details into an exact LaTeX source file and a rendered PDF.

## Product

- CV Workbench helps people build an ATS-friendly CV with clear sections for their summary, experience, achievements, skills, education, certificates, and projects.
- People can choose a CV template, review generated XeLaTeX source, inspect compiler diagnostics, and download PDF or `.tex` output.
- The interactive builder is available at https://cvworkbench.com/app.

## Primary page

- [CV Workbench](https://cvworkbench.com/): public product overview and entry point to the CV builder.
